threshold_declaration: Exploratory 5% of initial cash, fixed before the new matrix; historical corrected full-period baselines were already known. Not an economic/statistical robustness standard and not tuned to the new results.
window_semantics: Independent fresh cash/flat start; MA warmup within window. Full overlaps subwindows. Unequal-duration raw PnLs are not equivalent returns or additive slices; no annualization.
seed_semantics: fill_probability=1 and reject_probability=0; degenerate seed axis, not independent replications
authorization: Cached-file offline research only. No fetch, training, parameter promotion, licence-risk acceptance, or live trading. Aster remains appendix-only.
